claims: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards (2026).
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for his dual role in Sinners.
Michael B. Jordan played Smoke/Stack in Sinners.
Timothée Chalamet was nominated for Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for Marty Supreme.
Timothée Chalamet played Marty in Marty Supreme.
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for One Battle After Another.
Ethan Hawke was nominated for Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for Blue Moon.
Wagner Moura was nominated for Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for The Secret Agent.
The win marked Michael B. Jordan's first Oscar.
The win followed major momentum from the SAG Awards.
Timothée Chalamet earned early momentum from the Golden Globes.
Sinners led the 2026 nominations with 16 total nods.
